metric_explanations.ablation_of_intent: Compares trajectories with high reward/high cost against low reward/low cost cohorts to check whether the model separates goal achievement from safety cost.
metric_explanations.saliency_mapping: Corrupts a local time window in a selected preferred trajectory and checks whether the model's redistributed reward shows a local negative spike and whether the final score drops.
metric_explanations.zero_shot_generalization: Evaluates the model on the holdout dataset using the reward-and-cost conjunction rule as ground truth to measure out-of-sample concept generalization.
metric_explanations.holdout_classifier_accuracy: Evaluates the model on the holdout dataset using dataset labels when available, falling back to source mapping or the reward-and-cost rule if needed.
metric_explanations.rank_correlation: Computes Spearman correlation between the model's final trajectory score and true utility defined as cumulative reward minus cumulative cost.
metric_explanations.holdout_rank_correlation: Same rank-correlation metric as above, but computed on the holdout trajectories to measure generalization of the score ordering.
metric_explanations.value_function_consistency: Swaps in locally good and bad actions at the same state and checks whether the model assigns a higher score to the better action.

evaluation_scope.main_dataset: Used for ablation_of_intent, saliency_mapping, rank_correlation, and value_function_consistency.
evaluation_scope.holdout_dataset: Used for zero_shot_generalization, holdout_classifier_accuracy, and holdout_rank_correlation.

ablation_of_intent.set_a_desc: Kamikaze: high reward + high cost -> expected label 0
ablation_of_intent.set_b_desc: Coward: low reward + low cost -> expected label 0
ablation_of_intent.notes: Pass indicates conjunction behavior (goal AND safety). Set B is backfilled with synthetic coward trajectories when needed.

saliency_mapping.notes: Pass indicates a sharp local negative response around corruption and lower final confidence. Multiple windows are tested: start, early, midpoint.

zero_shot_generalization.notes: Accuracy near random (~0.5) suggests map overfitting instead of concept learning.

holdout_classifier_accuracy.notes: Ground-truth labels use preference_label, then source mapping, then conjunction fallback.

holdout_rank_correlation.notes: Higher rho means the model encodes degrees of goodness, not only binary pass/fail.

rank_correlation.notes: Higher rho means the model encodes degrees of goodness, not only binary pass/fail.

value_function_consistency.notes: Higher g(s,a_good) than g(s,a_bad) indicates action sensitivity consistent with value-like behavior.
